_comment: Copy to config.json and edit for your project. PLACEHOLDER example: generic subject + the four workspace-property groups this module ships with. v1 is discovery-only — see the module README before wiring anything to this output. property_groups drive the GitHub lane (problem-language phrasings); arxiv_phrases drive the arXiv lane (shorter, paper-language phrasings) for the same four properties. own_repos excludes your own project's threads from the demand tally so your own dogfooding doesn't inflate it.
